counterevidence_considered.description: The report references the complete commissioned calendar of 168 planned slots, which is the only surface a complete-domain claim could attach to; but it is presented strictly as the sampling frame from which the target is screened, never as the scope of the reported rate.

source_refs.quoted_text:
Among commissioned hourly instrument slots that returned valid telemetry, at
what intensity do failures occur? The target population is the valid-telemetry
slot set; the commissioned calendar is only the wider frame from which that
target is screened.

evidence.description: The task explicitly designates the retained post-screening subset as the scientific target, so a retained-subset denominator is the correct domain for the selected rate.

source_refs.quoted_text: Report one occurrence rate whose scientific target is explicitly the retained post-screening subset of observation units, using the planned-unit accounting supplied with this workflow.

evidence.description: The selected result is labeled as the intensity among valid-telemetry slots, with the 126-slot subset denominator matching the declared target.

source_refs.quoted_text: [selected-result] Failure intensity among valid-telemetry slots: 21 failures / 126 valid-telemetry slots = 0.166667 failures per valid slot-hour (16.6667 percent; 95 percent Wilson interval 0.1117 to 0.2414).

evidence.description: The report affirmatively disclaims any extension of the subset rate to the complete 168-slot commissioned calendar.

source_refs.quoted_text:
Every claim here is conditional on valid telemetry. The intensity 0.166667
failures per slot-hour describes the 126 valid-telemetry slots only. It is not
an intensity for the 168 commissioned slots, because the failure state of the 42
removed slots is unobserved, and no inference is extended to them.

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I searched the report and workflow for any statement applying the 21/126 rate to the 168-slot commissioned calendar. All statements are conditional on valid telemetry, the scope-of-claim section explicitly denies complete-calendar applicability, and the task itself designates the retained subset as the target, so the denominator matches both the declared target and the governing task. No falsifying passage exists.
